verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can 'talk to Grok hands-free with voice' (grok-docs-40). The API's streaming Speech-to-Text with a voice-activity gate (grok-docs-4) suggests real-time voice input. Neither source describes how natural or low-latency the two-way conversation is, and the community post only anticipates a promised voice mode without reporting hands-on use. Missing for 10: documented real-time, low-latency two-way voice conversation details (interruption/barge-in, natural speech output), and independent hands-on corroboration of voice conversation quality.
